verses.text: "Be careful not to do your good deeds in front of other people just so they will see you. If you do, you will get no reward from your Father in heaven.

"So when you give to people in need, do not blow a trumpet to announce it. That is what the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, so that people will praise them. I tell you for certain, they have already received their full reward.
But when you give to people in need, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.
Then your giving will be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

"When you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. They love to stand and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners, so that people will see them. I tell you for certain, they have already received their full reward.
But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who cannot be seen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
When you pray, do not keep saying the same words over and over, like people who do not know God. They think God will hear them because they use so many words.
Do not be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask him.
"This is how you should pray: 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
May your kingdom come. May what you want be done on earth, as it is done in heaven.
Give us today the food we need.
Forgive us the wrong things we have done, as we also forgive those who have done wrong to us.
Do not lead us into temptation, but save us from the evil one. For the kingdom, the power and the glory are yours for ever. Amen.'
If you forgive other people when they sin against you, your Father in heaven will also forgive you.
But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.

"When you fast, do not look sad like the hypocrites do. They make their faces look miserable so that people will see they are fasting. I tell you for certain, they have already received their full reward.
But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face.
Then people will not know that you are fasting, but only your Father, who cannot be seen, will know. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
"Do not store up treasures for yourselves here on earth, where moths and rust destroy them, and where thieves break in and steal them.
Instead, store up treasures for yourselves in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and where thieves cannot break in and steal them.
Where your treasure is, that is where your heart will be too.
"The eye is like a lamp for the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If the light inside you is really darkness, how dark that darkness is!
"No one can serve two masters. They will hate one and love the other, or they will be loyal to one and look down on the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

"So I tell you, do not worry about your life, about what you will eat or drink. And do not worry about your body, about what you will wear. Life is more important than food, and the body is more important than clothes.
Look at the birds in the sky. They do not plant seeds or gather a harvest or store food in barns, but your Father in heaven feeds them. Are you not worth much more than they are?
Can any of you add even one hour to your life by worrying?
"And why do you worry about clothes? Look at how the wild flowers grow. They do not work or make clothes for themselves.
But I tell you that not even King Solomon in all his splendour was dressed as beautifully as one of these flowers.
God dresses the grass in the fields like this, even though it is here today and thrown into the fire tomorrow. So he will certainly take even better care of you. Your faith is so small!
So do not worry and say, 'What will we eat?' or 'What will we drink?' or 'What will we wear?'
People who do not know God run after all these things. But your Father in heaven knows that you need them.
Put God's kingdom first, and do what he says is right. Then all these things will be given to you as well.
So do not worry about tomorrow. Tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own."
